name: Morocco
dossier:
The Morocco national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Atlas Lions, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 11 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The continent's standard-bearers, carrying a billion dreams and a defence that strangles giants.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Morocco will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group C and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group C. The connection between Achraf Hakimi and Brahim Díaz is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Achraf Hakimi - the clinical wing-back who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Morocco are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Morocco became the first African and Arab nation to reach a World Cup semi-final in 2022  -  and they are no longer a surprise.
Morocco boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Fourth place (2022).
